text.p: Bio-Vascular Inc said Wednesday that M. Karen Gilles was named president and chief executive officer, succeeding John Karcanes, who has tendered his resignation.
Gilles served as chief financial officer of the company since December 1990, vice president of finance since 1989 and secretary of the company since 1991.

"Bio-Vascular is in a very strong financial position and has an exciting array of medium- and long-term growth opportunities," Karcanes said in a statement. "However, I sincerely believe that different leadership is needed to fully execute the company's strategic plan. And while my future plans are uncertain, it is the right time to make a significant change."
Bio-Vascular manufactures and markets proprietary specialty medical products for use in thoracic, cardiac, neuro and vascular surgery.
